title: PCSO Lotto Results: Over P253M Grand Lotto 6/55 prize at stake after no winners of major jackpot draws on Oct.7
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on October 7, 2026, as the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot topped P253 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Wednesday.

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on October 7, 2026, as the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot topped P253 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Wednesday.
No bettor selected the winning numbers of 26-31-46-23-12-06 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of P253,978,527.08.
According to PCSO, the odds of winning the jackpot for the Grand Lotto 6/55 are 1 in 28,989,675. To win, bettors must match all six numbers chosen from a field of 1 to 55.
Winners remained elusive as well for Megalotto 6/45, with no one picking the correct combination of 32-23-28-38-26-17 that would have yielded the P96,418,628.55 jackpot.
